connector.name: Qiskit IBM Runtime MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for IBM Quantum computing services through Qiskit IBM Runtime
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package qiskit-ibm-runtime-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the qiskit account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: QISKIT_IBM_TOKEN
env.description: Your IBM Quantum API token for authentication

env.name: QISKIT_IBM_RUNTIME_MCP_INSTANCE
env.description: IBM Quantum instance CRN for faster startup (skips instance lookup)
